# kion_custom_variable (Resource)

Manages a Kion Custom Variable.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kion_custom_variable" "example" {
  # Optional
  # default_value_list       = []
  # default_value_map        = {}
  # default_value_string     = "example"
  # description              = "example"
  # key_validation_message   = "example"
  # key_validation_regex     = "example"
  # last_updated             = "example"
  # name                     = "example"
  # owner_user_group_ids     = []
  # owner_user_ids           = []
  # type                     = "example"
  # value_validation_message = "example"
  # value_validation_regex   = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `default_value_list` (List of String) Default value when the custom variable type is list.
- `default_value_map` (Map of String) Default value when the custom variable type is map.
- `default_value_string` (String) Default value when the custom variable type is string.
- `description` (String) Description is the description of the custom variable. The description can be up to 1024 characters.
- `key_validation_message` (String) KeyValidationMessage is the message displayed when the custom variable key(s) do not match the regular expression.
The key validation message can be up to 255 characters.
- `key_validation_regex` (String) KeyValidationRegex is the regular expression used to validate the custom variable key(s) within the map custom
variable type. The key validation regex can be up to 255 characters.
- `last_updated` (String) The last time this resource was updated.
- `name` (String) Name is the name of the custom variable. The name can be up to 255 characters.
- `owner_user_group_ids` (Set of Number) OwnerUGroupIDs is the list of user group IDs who will own the custom variable.
- `owner_user_ids` (Set of Number) OwnerUserIDs is the list of user IDs who will own the custom variable.
- `type` (String) Type is the type of the custom variable. The supported types are string, list, and map.
- `value_validation_message` (String) ValueValidationMessage is the message displayed when the custom variable value(s) do not match the regular expression.
The validation message can be up to 255 characters.
- `value_validation_regex` (String) ValueValidationRegex is the regular expression used to validate the custom variable value(s).
The validation regex can be up to 255 characters.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Custom variable id.
